prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Behavior Soundboard Stage: Redesign the pick_friend screen into an interactive soundboard stage where users can click pet reaction cards to play sample audio and behavior previews before adopting.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Listen and Choose Your Companion", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "text": "Auditory Behavior Test", "action": "choose", "style": "playful"}]}}
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Display Mode Calibration Screen: Insert a dedicated desktop display test screen right after render waiting that verifies overlay visibility and multi-monitor position before going home.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_calibration", "home_intro"], "new_desktop_calibration": {"headline": "Calibrate Desktop Visibility", "body": "Verify your mascot renders properly on your current display.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "button", "label": "Test Desktop Visibility", "action": "next", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
2: [sign_in, new_flow] Account Sync & Pet Memory Protection Flow: Introduce a state-preservation sub-flow on sign-in that explicitly checks and preserves active local pet profiles prior to cloud authentication.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Secure Your Companion & Progress", "body": "Link your pet to cloud storage without resetting local progress.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Pet Safeguard Active", "style": "highlight"}]}}
3: [sign_in, reorder] Late Account Link Post Home Intro Reorder: Shift sign_in to occur immediately after home_intro so users experience their active desktop mascot before creating or linking an account.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "sign_in"], "sign_in": {"headline": "Save Your Companion Profile", "body": "Sign in now to sync your desktop pet to the cloud."}}
4: [choose_path, hint] Companion Path Time Expectation Notice: Add explicit time expectation hints explaining that preset adoption takes under 1 minute while custom generation takes ~3 minutes.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Preset path takes <1 minute. Custom generation takes ~3 minutes.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Instant Setup available", "style": "subtle"}]}}
5: [home, wait_info] Interactive Pet Trait Deck During Render: Provide an interactive carousel tip deck on the render waiting screen showing control tricks and sound cues while assets compile in the background.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Pet Controls & Tricks", "style": "rounded"}]}}
6: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Caretaker Badge & Name Customizer: Add an interactive pet naming input field and a Caretaker Badge seal directly on the adoption certificate.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "components": [{"type": "name_input", "label": "Give your pet a nickname", "style": "emphasis"}, {"type": "badge", "text": "Certified Caretaker", "style": "highlight"}]}}
7: [home, notification] Desktop Tray Notification Sound Alert: Trigger a subtle notification chime and taskbar highlight when render completion finishes in the background.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "sound", "label": "Completion Chime Alert", "action": "play", "style": "playful"}]}}
8: [finish, layout] Desktop Control Hotkey Cheat Sheet Grid: Reformat home_intro into a two-column grid showcasing system tray controls and hotkeys for hiding and interacting with the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "How to Interact With Your Pet", "body": "Use taskbar tray controls or quick hotkeys to summon, mute, or play with your companion.", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Desktop Control Basics", "style": "plain"}]}}
9: [choose_path, hint] Path Decision Safety Guarantee Badge: Display a hint confirming that users can switch, create, or adopt additional pets at any time from app settings.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Don't worry! You can adopt or build more pets anytime from the app menu.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Reversible Choice", "style": "subtle"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns the pick_friend screen while maintaining its required function of letting the user choose a pet.
Inserts a new calibration screen within onboarding without removing or skipping any required steps.
Enhances the sign-in sub-flow inside onboarding without violating any base rules.
Reorders sign-in after home_intro, which is explicitly permitted within onboarding.
Adds clear time expectation hints to choose_path without violating fair design or pricing rules.
Adds interactive trait tips during the waiting screen while retaining the waiting state.
Adds pet naming and a caretaker badge seal while retaining the official adoption certificate functionality.
Adds taskbar notification chimes upon render completion as permitted inside onboarding.
Reformats home_intro to show desktop controls without altering post-onboarding behavior.
Adds a reassurance hint to choose_path without violating pricing copy or fair design principles.
